purpose: Restore current NewsPortal operational configuration from a clean database baseline.
scope: Compact operational restore config only; excludes historical discovery runs, evidence, debates, repairs, coverage history and article/content state.
redactionPolicy: auth_config_json and secret-like JSON keys are redacted. Restore credentials from environment/secret storage before enabling authenticated channels.
suggestedRestoreOrder: Run migrations for the target environment first.
Restore sources/source_channels.json and rehydrate secrets externally if needed.
Optionally restore sources/source_channel_runtime_state.json to preserve polling cadence/backoff.
Restore discovery targets and operational endpoint/contract/provider config if continuing discovery from this funnel.
Run MCP read-back: system_interests.list, llm_templates.list, channels.list, discovery.source_families.coverage, operator.report.verify.
invariants: Source metadata/source health/source role/source family/source prior must not select, rank, escalate or publish content.
Web must show only final selected content.
Working noisy/low-yield semantic channels should be retained unless the operator explicitly disables them.
